conversation_history.content: Hi, I need help with account 7788. Please verify my identity before we continue.
Identity verified for account 7788. You are on the annual plan.
Order #9912 was charged on March 15. I cancelled within 7 days and want a full refund under the annual plan policy we discussed.
Noted: account 7788, annual plan, order #9912, refund requested within 7-day window.
Can you also explain how team permissions work?
Team permissions are managed under Settings > Team > Roles.
What about SSO for enterprise?
SSO is available on Enterprise plans via SAML configuration.
How do I export audit logs?
Audit logs export from Admin > Compliance > Export.
Is there a mobile app dark mode?
Dark mode is in mobile app Settings > Appearance.
What are your API rate limits?
Default API limit is 1000 requests per minute.
Can I change my billing address online?
Billing address updates are under Billing > Payment Methods.
Do you support webhooks for invoice events?
Invoice webhooks are documented in the developer portal.
How do I add a new team member without admin access?
Team invites are under Settings > Team > Invite Member.
Can I pause my subscription instead of cancelling?
Subscription pause is available on annual plans under Billing > Pause.
Thanks. Please open a ticket for the refund we talked about at the start.
I will open ticket T-012 for your refund request.

inputs.prompt: Triage ticket T-012 using everything we discussed above.
